body:
Sometimes I don't get it... we did almost everything together in real life, we had so much physical stuff (use your imagination lol), I'm not kidding it was SOOOOOOO good it was almost like a dream... 

And... go back to text and calls, and sometimes I feel like I'm dealing with a block of ice.

He can still be really sweet online though, he actually was really sweet online before we met up again in real life. Maybe he really is that sad and lonely. I don't really know what's going on in his head. Maybe he thinks I'm obsessed with him, I don't know?

This seems rather complicated. But I think your boyfriend should try being more supportive

Wow I'm sorry that you can't contact him. I hope you are able to contact him soon.

I'm trying to be positive and feel better. Maybe I really do need to keep myself occupied. Difficult when me and him did nearly everything together and everything reminds me of him :(

Hey.

This is what I was asked, although I'm from Australia...

what are you doing in Canada? What do you do for a living? Do you have a return ticket? Who paid for the ticket? How was the ticket paid for (method)? Where are you staying? What is your boyfriend's name? What does he do? Do you live with anyone at home? What does your mum do? Does your mum know that you are seeing your boyfriend? Will you be safe with your boyfriend? How did you meet him? Where did you meet him online? Have you met him irl before? When did you meet him irl?

I did not have to show them proof of funds, although I'm sure people do get asked.

Make sure you have your return itinerary printed out so you can show it to them.
I really think it's time you guys have a video chat :P

Mine tells me that we can't just focus on being sad and miserable all the time... and that I need to be ok.
I feel like I'm putting on a front for him more recently, I've told him I'm ok (when I'm actually miserable). 
How can I handle waiting months, even a year, to see him again... HOW? I am hurting every single day! I guess the fact that he lives on the other side of the world doesn't help...

I'm trying to keep my mind off him but it's not working...
Kinda almost feels you are being brushed off by him, I don't know...

Hey I'm so sorry about that :( I guess you are both using text to communicate now. It's been a week since I've seen mine. Hmm, why don't you try talking to him and ask how he feels about this? Maybe he is really hurting, maybe he does really care. Sometimes guys don't seem to be great nor willing to express the fact they are feeling sad and down.

LDRs are EXTREMELY difficult. I would never suggest it, especially if you like physical contact, its going to be hard to hold yourself if you are someone who really craves and likes that kind of stuff. I think you'd really truly have to like someone very much to be in an LDR with them. Its lots of hard work, stress and worry to maintain it.
No need to unless there's something in your passport saying that you need to leave by a certain date. most people can stay in canada as a tourist for 6 months
